reviews.text: Dallas Pool Works has taken care of our pool for many years. They are thorough, professional, and provide very high quality services. Most recently, DPW gave our pool a much needed face-lift that included updating the tile, professionally cleaning all stone work, replacing the plaster, and fixing / leveling the decking. The process was simple, low-stress, and Jarrod communicated frequently and clearly throughout the entire project. We could not be happier with the result and cannot recommend Jarrod, Blake, and Dallas Pool Works enough!!
reviews.author: Jonathan Helm

reviews.text:
Dallas Pool Works does the weekly cleaning and maintenance of my amazing fountain. For 3 years I had a beautiful fountain that hardly ever worked properly and I could not find a reliable fountain maintenance company. Dallas Pool Works was recommended to me by Jason DePauw of Select Pool Services who reworked my fountain and had had it up and running properly for the first time since it was built.

Alex, my service technician, comes weekly. He is prompt, polite, knowledgeable, and in a good mood! During the Dallas Freeze Jarrod, the owner, called to check on our fountain and walked me through the steps to drain the pump and shut the system down. He saved us from a situation where our pipes would have frozen and our motor burned up.

If I could give this company a 10 star review I would! Thank you Dallas Pool Works.
reviews.author: Debbie McEntire

reviews.text: We've been using Dallas Pool Works for just over a year, and they've been fantastic. They took over from another company that was unreliable, and the difference has been night and day. Dallas Pool Works is professional, responsive, and always keeps our pool in top shape. Not only do they handle routine maintenance and equipment care, but they also take care of everything—from stonework to lighting. It’s great knowing our pool is in expert hands. Highly recommend to anyone looking for reliable, high-quality pool service!
reviews.author: Tobe Thompson

reviews.text: Jarrod and Blake are top tier. After recently purchasing a house, the first pool company could not get the pool to stop turning green. Dallas pools solved the problem in a few days, and noticed other issues around the pool the other company did not catch. Phenomenal communication and excellent work. Look no further for a pool company.
reviews.author: Kyle K

reviews.text: We have worked with Jarrod and Blake at Dallas Pool Works for several years. They have always gone above and beyond to help us when we needed it. They are honest and up front about everything the pool needs and are super quick with any repairs needed. Over the years we have had the same 2 technicians, who are very reliable and thorough. (Our old pool company had a different tech every couple of months.) It is nice to see the same person every week in your backyard! Very happy with Dallas Pool Works!!
reviews.author: Susan Young

reviews.text: Have been a pool owner for years and I am here to say without exception that Dallas Pool Works and Jarrod are the best pool cleaning company we have ever used! Professional, Integrity, and  outstanding service, you won’t be disappointed!
reviews.author: Matt Carey

reviews.text: It has been a great pleasure (and a welcome change from our previous service company) having Dallas Pool Works care for our pool! Jarrod and Blake are professional, responsive and knowledgeable. They take pride in their work and it shows. Our equipment is running well, any necessary repairs are done promptly, and our weekly pool service has been very good and consistent. We'd highly recommend Dallas Pool Works to anyone who desires worry-free enjoyment of their pool.
reviews.author: Monika Burdett

reviews.text: I have been working with Dallas Pool Works for over a year. Their service is impeccable with great attention to detail. Our pool captures a lot of organic matter and no matter the season, they will stay until the pool is sparkling clean each time. Jarrod is very responsive and proactive at making sure our pool is well cared for. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Hunter Satterfield
